newsitem.title: USA: 3com sees charge of $7 mln from deal.
newsitem.headline: 3com sees charge of $7 mln from deal.

text.p: 3Com Corp said it completed the acquisition of OnStream Networks Inc and expects to record a one-time charge of about $7 million against fiscal second quarter earnings for costs and fees associated with the deal.

In the $258 million acquisition, announced on October 7, 3Com exchanged 3.8 million shares and options, for all outstanding shares and options of OnStream, a leading provider of Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) and broadband wide area network (WAN) and access products.
The acquisition will be accounted for as a pooling-of-interests, it said.

3Com said the acquisition of OnStream extends its leadership in the enterprise ATM market and strengthens its available product solutions for the network service provider (NSP) and Internet service provider (ISP) markets.

Among other benefits, it enables 3Com to offer customers standards-based, cost-effective solutions for aggregating voice, video and data traffic and adapting it to ATM for transport across both local area networks and wide area networks.
